# Volt UI Recipes

> Copyable blocks, application layouts and tested recipes built from Volt UI, an open-source Angular component library built on ng-primitives. Every example has a live preview, complete source and install instructions. Blocks, layouts and recipes are source you copy into your project, not library exports.

Volt UI itself — the components, theming and API reference — is documented at https://voltui.dev. This site is available in English, Spanish and Ukrainian.

## Documentation

- [Adding a recipe](https://recipes.voltui.dev/docs/adding-a-recipe): The steps for contributing a block, a layout or a recipe to Volt UI Recipes.
- [Blocks, layouts and recipes](https://recipes.voltui.dev/docs/blocks-layouts-recipes): How a block, a layout and a recipe differ, and when to reach for each.
- [Copying a recipe](https://recipes.voltui.dev/docs/copying-a-recipe): Install the packages a block, layout or recipe needs, copy its source and check it compiles in your project.
- [Introduction](https://recipes.voltui.dev/docs/introduction): What Volt UI Recipes is, what it publishes and how it relates to the Volt UI component library.
